title: HelioFITS Suite
description: The HelioFITS Suite is desktop software for looking at solar and heliospheric imagery. HelioFITS Peek teaches macOS Finder and Quick Look to read solar FITS files; HelioFITS Studio, a fork of JHelioviewer, is a viewer for coronagraph and wide-field data with the Helioradial projections and the RHEF filter; Heliogram is a companion app for public outreach. Each program is versioned and archived separately, with its own DOI; this record is the suite's umbrella and lists them as its parts.
